zones: battlefield and last-known battlefield source state
objects: source permanent and resulting triggered ability
state_writes: APNAP trigger batch and stack object
timing: after the triggering event and before priority
targets: targets are selected when the trigger is put on the stack
hidden_information: only legal projected target candidates are exposed
apnap: trigger batches are placed in APNAP order
layers: last-known source characteristics may depend on continuous effects
replacement_effects: the final replaced event determines whether the trigger condition occurred
copy: copied triggered abilities preserve controller and source context
control_change: self departure triggers use the source's last known controller
zone_change: self events match stable object references and pre-move active zones
source_leaves: self dies and leaves triggers retain last known controller

known_blockers: intervening-if, reflexive, delayed, and leaves-the-graveyard trigger grammar is not generic
trigger instructions with multiple clauses or player choices remain residual
generated trigger effects remain provisional until every effect dependency is trusted
